entity_name: CG Power and Industrial Solutions Limited

business_model.narrative_summary: CG Power is transitioning from a traditional capital equipment supplier to a high-technology industrial powerhouse through massive transformer capacity scaling, entry into railway safety electronics, and strategic foray into semiconductor design and OSAT packaging.

capital_allocation_philosophy.narrative: Dynamic capital allocation with a focus on greenfield and brownfield expansions.

execution_track_record.narrative: Sustained execution over 4 consecutive profitable years (FY22–FY25).

forward_guidance.narrative: High revenue visibility backed by a significant unexecuted order book.

communication_transparency.narrative: Exemplary corporate governance under the Murugappa Group.

governance_and_board.narrative: Professional board with a stable promoter stake of ~58%.

promoter_skin_in_game.narrative: Murugappa Group maintains a controlling stake, ensuring alignment with shareholder interests.
